name: Charm
overview: Scripture warns against seeking charm through occult practices or sorcery, as seen in Leviticus 19:31 and Acts 8:9, where such pursuits defile and deceive. True favor and influence are not found in outward beauty or deceitful charms but in the fear of the LORD, which brings genuine praise (Proverbs 31:30). The Lord condemns those who use deceptive means to manipulate others, emphasizing that His will is sovereign and unchangeable (Job 23:13; Ezekiel 13:18). Thus, biblical charm is not about manipulation or enchantment but about living in reverent obedience to God.
